notes: The also is added: rule 51 places it on a waw where one stands, and this clause's waw has already been spent on that.

The competing reading gives the waw a discontinuous that … also under rules 25 and 51; it was declined because also is neither a coordinator nor a subordinator, so rule 55's pair does not cover it and the counting principle leaves the surplus word beside the renderings rather than inside one.
כַּאֲשֶׁר fuses to the single as (rule 30), headed on the comparative preposition.
